title: Gold Reserves: Diversified By Address, Concentrated By Risk
summary:
De Nederlandsche Bank's gold move is a reminder that reserves can be diversified by address yet concentrated by failure mode, argues Amir Naser Hojati.
The post Gold Reserves: Diversified By Address, Concentrated By Risk appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: De Nederlandsche Bank's recent gold strategy highlights an important risk in reserve management. While central banks often diversify their gold holdings across different physical addresses and locations for security, these reserves may still share the same systemic vulnerabilities and failure modes. Experts argue that geographic distribution alone does not eliminate concentrated risks associated with global financial systems.
